text:
COBALT RIDGE SOFTWARE INC.
Human Resources Department -- Internal Complaint Record

Complainant: Sarah Mitchell, Senior Software Engineer
Employee SSN on file: 512-34-6789
Home address: 742 Maple Street, Springfield, IL 62704
Email: sarah.mitchell@example.com
Phone: (312) 555-0148

On the afternoon of August 6th, Ms. Mitchell reported to Human
Resources that she had been passed over for a promotion she believes
she was qualified for, and that the decision was communicated to her
in a manner she found dismissive. She is requesting a formal review of
the promotion process and back pay of $4,250.00 corresponding to the
salary differential since the position was filled.

This complaint was received and logged by Jennifer Park, HR Business Partner, on behalf of Cobalt Ridge Software Inc. A follow-up meeting has been scheduled with the employee's manager and the HR director.
